The '''hall of mirrors''' was an attraction located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It consisted in a maze-like room filled with [[Mirror/Legends|mirrors]], designed to confuse those who enter.

==History==
It was in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[Finn (boy)|Finn]] passed through it while chasing Finn's malfunctioning [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]].
